A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study. Their main text, figures, tables, equations and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material moved between sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original fairness and accuracy experiments on eight datasets, parameter sweeps, context-size ablations and sensitive-attribute reconstruction experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds TabDPT evaluations and an Adult-dataset comparison with LLM-based ICL methods.

M1.justification: The correlation-removal, group-balanced selection and uncertainty-based selection procedures remain substantively unchanged. TabDPT is an additional evaluated backbone. Appendix B.3 documents the existing conformal-selection procedure, and the train-only correlation-removal variant already appeared in v1.

E1.justification: v3 adds an Adult-dataset evaluation in Section 4.4 and Table 1. The five ACS tasks, Diabetes, German Credit and tabular CelebA task are retained.

E2.justification: TabDPT joins the TabPFN–TabICL comparisons. The new Adult comparison includes vanilla LLaMA-2-13B, Hu et al. (2024) using GPT-3.5-turbo, and Bhaila et al. (2024) using LLaMA-2-13B. These substantially broaden the reported comparator set.

E3.justification: v3 adds TabDPT evaluations under its default configuration and an Adult comparison reporting accuracy, DP and EOP rather than the original four-metric set including EOD. The retained 80/20 split, five-fold evaluation and fixed intervention parameters are unchanged. The newly stated calibration split is additional disclosure.

E4.justification: The fairness–accuracy parameter sweeps are extended to TabDPT, including Figures 10 and 12. The context-size ablation and train-only correlation-removal investigation already existed in v1 Appendices C and D; their appearance in Sections 4.3 and 4.5 is relocation.

E5.justification: Both versions specify shuffled five-fold cross-validation across ten independent random seeds and report means and standard deviations. No increase in runs or new confidence-interval or significance-testing procedure is reported.

E6.justification: v3 adds substantial TabDPT results and the Adult comparison: Uncertain+TabPFN reports 82.05±1.0 accuracy and 5.51±1.4 DP, versus 85.72±0.3 and 16.99±1.0 for vanilla TabPFN. All 160 mean/standard-deviation entries in v1 Table 4 match v3 Table 5. Section 4.2.1 also introduces an erroneous percentage notation for the retained ACSIncome example.

T1.justification: New Appendix B.3 formalizes the nonconformity score, calibration quantile and prediction-set construction in Equations 11–14 and states the exchangeability assumption. Existing fairness and correlation-removal mathematics remains substantively unchanged; no new theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The contribution list and conclusion retain the same central claims: three preprocessing interventions, uncertainty-based selection improving group fairness with a modest accuracy tradeoff, and no foundation-model retraining. The expanded evaluations provide additional support.

C2.justification: v3 adds specific discussion of difficult low-disparity cases on ACSPublicCoverage and Diabetes, qualifies the use of older LLM baselines, and interprets the real-versus-synthetic pretraining comparison. It also explicitly recommends train-only correlation removal while retaining the existing leakage explanation.

D1.justification: Appendix B.3 newly discloses the 50/50 proper-training/calibration split and details uncertainty computation. v3 also specifies default foundation-model parameters and random subsampling when context limits are exceeded. These disclosures do not establish changes to retained experiments; code access remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds TabDPT and Real-TabPFN literature and distinguishes fairness-oriented uncertainty selection from informativeness-oriented selection through Mavromatis et al. and Kung et al. These are targeted positioning updates; the distinction from FairPFN and retraining-based fairness approaches remains.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, related work and results discussion are extensively rewritten. Related work gains topical subdivisions, problem setup moves into Methodology, dataset descriptions move to Appendix A, and two appendix analyses move into the main text.

P2.justification: v3 changes the document template, typography and figure/table placement. It adds the Adult table and TabDPT figures, expands model-comparison plots and legends, and relocates existing analyses. Correlation-removal captions are corrected and the existing variants are labeled S1/S2.

improvement.justification: Added calibration details, TabDPT evidence and discussion of difficult low-disparity datasets modestly strengthen reproducibility and empirical grounding over v1. The gain is limited by incomplete matching details for the Adult comparison and overstated accuracy-preservation wording: Table 1 reports 85.72% for vanilla TabPFN versus 82.05% for Uncertain+TabPFN. Appendix B.3 also leaves a conflict between its quantile/set formulas and its explanation that decreasing epsilon selects fewer examples.
